csv_project_name: Design for North Field Ph 1A Housing Development
csv_agency: Mesa Grande Band of Mission Indians
csv_scope_of_work: Mesa Grande Indian Housing Authority (MGIHA) invites qualified firms to submit proposals for Planning and Design Services for the North Field Phase 1A housing development. This project will deliver new housing units on tribal trust land for members of the Mesa Grande Band of Mission Indians (MGBOMI) who are homeless or at risk of homelessness. The selected firm will serve as the lead planning and design consultant for the project, responsible for delivering all architecture, engineering, and environmental planning services required to bring the project to construction-ready status.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Energy Engineering, Utility Engineering, Wastewater Treatment Engineering
